paragraphs: R. Yaakov, without further designation, who is mentioned in the Gemara. She'erit Yosef writes that he is R. Yoḥanan's student (see below: he frequently said, 'R. Yoḥanan said'). In Mo'ed Katan (25b): when R. Yaakov died (in Ein Yaakov: bar Aḥa), stars appeared in the daytime.

I shall set before you those who speak in the name of R. Yaakov without further designation, and you may discern whether this is the R. Yaakov of the Mishnah and baraita, Rabbi's teacher, or the R. Yaakov of the Gemara, R. Yoḥanan's student.

He said, 'R. Oshaya said,' Berakhot (11, end of side a). R. Ilai said: R. Yaakov said: R. Abba bar Aḥa said. Elazar ben Yehudah of Avelim, in R. Yaakov's name. He said, 'Rav Ḥisda said,' Berakhot (29b, 34a). R. Yehudah ben Nekosa (Rabbi's student), in his name. R. Yehudah the Nasi, in the name of R. Yaakov, who said it in R. Meir's name, Gittin (14b). He said, 'R. Yehoshua ben Levi said.' He said, 'R. Yoḥanan said,' Shabbat (81a, 145b), Pesaḥim (25a, 91b), Mo'ed Katan (5, beginning of side a), Ketubbot (33b), Ḥullin (81b), Menaḥot (42a). He said, 'R. Yose bar Shaul said.' R. Yaakov bought a sandal and R. Yirmeyah bought bread on their festival day; they called one another 'orphans,' Avodah Zarah (13b). He said to R. Yirmeyah, 'I shall explain it to you,' Mo'ed Katan (18a). He said to R. Yirmeyah bar Taḥlifa, 'I shall explain it to you.' In R. Meir's name, Bava Metzia (75b); see above. He said, 'R. Mani said'; and R.N. [ר״נ; provisionally R. Naḥman]. In bar Padda's name. Ravin said: R. Yaakov said. (See Yose ben Shaul.)
